annual_economic_normalization: duration_days / 365.25; identical to saved economic figures
washing_count_normalization: event count / 10 nominal years, 2016–2025; final source hour unavailable
hourly_time_convention: Open-Meteo hour ends shifted -1 h after PV calculation; interval starts in UTC
energy_normalization: clean-production-weighted aggregate fractions, annual values separately exported
orientation_metrics: extra band energy loss without manual cleaning
extra band cost after independent optimization
transitions: adjacent simulated threshold brackets; no inferred exact crossing
figure_representation: one line per module/orientation; no confidence intervals; statistics file min/max is dispersion between configurations
